start_here: Say to your AI: "List every video that https://site.example plays, across its pages." It runs tool:list-the-videos-a-site-plays and hands back the video files, streams and player frames it found and the pages it opened.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: it reads one public site and answers the addresses it found, writing nothing.
instructions: 1. Pick the public site's first page address; the tool never signs in, so only what anyone can see is read.
2. Say "List the videos this site plays" with the address as url; the AI runs tool:list-the-videos-a-site-plays.
3. It opens at most 25 pages of the same site, scrolls each ten times and records video requests and video, source and iframe addresses.
4. Read videos for the addresses, pages for what it opened, and remaining_pages for pages it left because of the 25-page bound.
